tagline: Drawbar organ with nine sine drawbars and a rotary-style effect
description: An 8-voice drawbar organ that adds nine sine waves at the standard drawbar footages, in the manner of a tonewheel organ. A simple rotary-speaker effect (pitch wobble from a modulated delay plus tremolo, slow or fast) and a percussion click are applied to each voice.

features.name: 9 drawbars
features.description: 16', 5⅓', 8', 4', 2⅔', 2', 1⅗', 1⅓' and 1', each a sine at that harmonic with a level from 0 to 1

features.name: Rotary-style effect
features.description: A sine LFO moves a short delay (2 ms, up to 5 ms) for pitch wobble and adds tremolo; Slow is 0.7 Hz, Fast is 6 Hz, with Depth and Mix controls

features.name: Percussion click
features.description: A short transient at the start of each note, with level and a decay of 10 ms to 500 ms

features.name: 8-voice polyphony
features.description: Eight voices; velocity sets the note level

useCases: Full organ - most drawbars out with the fast rotary setting
Mellow jazz tones - 16', 8' and 4' only, slow rotary
Bright, thin registrations - upper drawbars with the click up
Learning additive synthesis - hear each harmonic by pulling one drawbar at a time
